games.title: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
games.description: Станьте частиною історії від початку до грандіозного фіналу серії ігор Attack on Titan. Гра з використанням пристрою просторового маневрування (ODM) стала ще просунутішою й забезпечує найзахопливіші та найстильніші бої в історії серії.

games.title: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.description: Нова пригода в серії фентезійних ігор із головоломками «Професор Лейтон», продажі якої перевищили 20 млн копій у всьому світі. Професор Лейтон і Люк беруться за загадкову справу в Стім-Байсоні — місті винаходів, що працює завдяки паровим технологіям.

games.title: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
games.description: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.title: A-Train 9 PRIME LINE
games.description: The ultimate edition of the city-building simulation game A-Train 9! As the president of a railway company, build the city of your dreams through city building and railway management. A-Train 9 PRIME LINE takes city building beyond evolution, delivering the ultimate city-building experience.

games.title: Rayman Legends Retold
games.description: Відкрийте сміливе переосмислення улюбленого платформера з оновленою графікою та свіжим поглядом на знайомий сюжет. Грайте в соло-режимі або збирайте компанію до 4 осіб для гри в кооперативному режимі на одній консолі. Досліджуйте таємничий новий світ, проходьте нові музичні рівні та багато іншого!

games.title: STAGE TOUR
games.description: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.title: FreeStyle Football 2
games.description: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

games.title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.description: Тіні — ваші союзники. Поверніться до міста як майстер-злодій Garrett у цій оновленій класичній грі від Nightdive Studios. Крадіжки, підступні витівки та хитрощі у світі, де довіра — це розкіш, а кожна вкрадена таємниця має свою ціну.

games.title: Arcane Treasures: Trading Card Game
games.description: Build a whimsical deck of cartoon animals to battle foes & uncover special treasures in this cute but competitive online Trading Card Game! Collect trading cards featuring indie artists' works, open booster packs, and complete challenges to expand your collection!

games.title: Escape from the Collector
games.description: 'Escape from the Collector' is a first-person puzzle adventure set inside an old house filled with strange mechanisms and secrets. Explore its rooms, follow the traces of a forgotten story, and solve the puzzles standing between you and the way out.

games.title: Your place
games.description: A cozy solitude simulator where a rainy night, a computer, and music create an atmosphere of calm and relaxation. Play an arcade game, explore the internet through an in-game browser, and import your own music to create the perfect atmosphere to unwind.

games.title: Factory Island
games.description: Factory Island is an experimental game built to display 3D worlds inside a 2D renderer. Explore procedurally generated maps, build voxel structures, invite your friends to multiplayer, experiment with water and simple electronics, fight creatures and create mods for this game-engine project.

games.title: Orc Warchief: Prologue
games.description: Prologue version of Orc Warchief. Become an Orc warchief and fight for survival of your race. Rebuild your village and train your warriors. Gather resources and craft your weapons. Raise your warbanner and gather The Horde.

games.title: Project OutFox
games.description: Project OutFox is mod friendly, cross-platform rhythm game engine based on StepMania, featuring 21 different modes simulating different dance, sensor, instrument and key-based rhythm games. Play your way through 25+ years of community content and relive your nostalgia and try to outfox your friends!

games.title: better.game
games.description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Client-side customizable. Players can see and hear different things. Moving spherical zone. Build, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Lose, view an instant replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

games.title: 秋之轻语
games.description: VN.Your neighbor died in a fall — yet the very next day, she appeared inside your mind, as if an unseen hand were pulling every string. Everything feels dreamlike, unreal. You seem to have boarded a train that accelerates beyond control; in the chaos, you clutch at something — perhaps the truth.

games.title: Ghost Merc: Frontlines
games.description: A fast-paced, team-based FPS. Engage in intense firefights, coordinate with your clan, and adapt your strategy to dominate the battlefield. Featuring a competitive clan system, objective-based modes, and deep customization, every match is a test of skill and teamwork.

games.title: Anne & Mary's Hunt for Booty
games.description: Anne and Mary's Hunt for Booty is a fast-paced 2D beat 'em up. Play as historical pirates Anne Bonny and/or Mary Read, shoot and slash through the British fleet, and save the cowardly captain from a nasty privateer! Features swashbucklin' beats, local co-op, and art stylized by '90s cartoons.

games.title: Honeycomb Coins
games.description: Honeycomb Coins is a free-to-play, coin-fighting, 1vs1 turn-based strategy board game. Online support. Win the game to get coins and collect coins of various designs!

games.title: Unwound
games.description: Earthquakes are threatening idyllic Candy Island! Pull yourself together and get to the bottom of what’s troubling the island and its eccentric residents before your whole world breaks apart. UNWOUND is a rollicking yarn: a narrative RPG where people are objects and candy is currency.

games.title: Keyframes
games.description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

games.title: Aetherian Chronicles
games.description: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

games.title: Am I Nima
games.description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.title: No Body No Problem!
games.description: Один із вас поліцейський. Решта охоплені панікою підозрювані. Сховайте тіло, знищте докази, не видавайте одне одного й позбудьтеся всього до того, як ваш друг-поліцейський постукає у двері. Правило одне: якщо тіло знайдуть, вам усім кінець.

games.title: Arctic Drive
games.description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

games.title: Winx Club - Moonlight Quest
games.description: Здіймайся в політ назустріч абсолютно новій пригоді Winx Club («Клуб Вінкс»)! Грай за Блум, перевтілюйся та вільно досліджуй відкритий світ, натхненний серіалом. Розгадай таємницю Фестивалю 100 місяців.

games.title: Dirt Town
games.description: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

games.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic
games.description: Подивіться на світ очима хороброго мишеняти в цій чарівній кооперативній 3D-пригоді. Досліджуйте приголомшливі місцини, натхненні північною Швецією, розв’язуйте головоломки й творіть добро у світі, де зворушливі історії переплітаються з красою природи.

games.title: PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK
games.description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

games.title: Dumpster Gang
games.description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.title: Reshine
games.description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.title: Flak Simulator
games.description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

games.title: HUNGER
games.description: HUNGER throws you into the chaos of plague-ravaged Napoleonic Europe. This multiplayer extraction RPG blends brutal melee and ranged combat with deep long term character progression, questing and crafting. Scavenge for resources, battle unspeakable horrors, and outlast rival Living.

games.title: The Brave Few
games.description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

games.title: 楽園追放 -The Stellar Angel-
games.description: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

games.title: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
games.description: У цій кооперативній PVE-пригоді ви досліджуєте стародавній ліс, збираєте ресурси, майстрюєте предмети та будуєте домівку серед верхівок дерев. На вас чекають ветте — істоти скандинавського фольклору, які можуть бути і дружніми, і небезпечними. Грайте самостійно або в компанії до 8 гравців.

games.title: Me and You
games.description: Me and You — кооперативна головоломка, натхненна визнаною «Baba Is You». Створюйте, змінюйте та порушуйте правила кожного рівня, щоб пройти його разом.

games.title: Shark Mart
games.description: Shark Mart - це шалений кооперативний симулятор про акул під прикриттям, що маскуються під привітних дельфінів. Керуй магазином і відмивай китів, щоб потай викрадати довірливих рибок і готувати з них смачні делікатеси! Але стережися - Рибна поліція прагне викрити твою зубасту таємницю...

games.title: Lost Bitcoin
games.description: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

games.title: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot
games.description: Інкрементальна гра про лут, у якій ти скидаєш своїх героїв на орди слаймів. Вони б’ються, а ти збираєш здобич і наповнюєш скриню скарбів. Коли час спливає, скриня вибухає, і все знову сиплеться дощем. Прокачуй армію у величезному дереві навичок і вирушай знову по ще більший улов!

games.title: Orion Blue
games.description: Orion Blue is a cozy fishing adventure set on a beautiful alien planet. Catch fish, gather resources, and build relationships with the locals. Play actively, or relax and let the game progress with Idle Mode.

games.title: No Mercy
games.description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

games.title: AetherCycle
games.description: AetherCycle is a first-person action RPG featuring fast-paced combat, character leveling, abilities, and loot-driven gear progression. Explore a vast world, conquer dungeons, and grow stronger solo or in co-op as the Cycle affects the world.

games.title: A Sector Darkly
games.description: Command a ship and crew stranded far from home in this open-world space sandbox RPG. Explore, trade, fight, and craft to survive among the strange alien factions. One by one entire sectors are going dark and no one knows why. Solve the mystery of the dark sectors and get your crew home.

games.title: Arkheron
games.description: Arkheron is a fast-paced, team-based PvP game where items grant powerful abilities to master. Combine them to outplay rival teams with skill and creativity as you fight your way up the Tower. Every run challenges you to adapt, survive, and master new combinations.

games.title: GrimKeep
games.description: GrimKeep — це роглайт-дайсбілдер у кошмарній казці. Знаходь предмети, кидай кістки й оптимізуй свій білд, щоб завдавати колосальної шкоди. Прорубайся крізь жахи проклятого міста до Принцеси. А потім прикінчи її.

games.title: Carry On Together
games.description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

games.title: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
games.description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

games.title: Blind Descent
games.description: Blind Descent — гра на виживання у відкритому світі, де вам доведеться розкривати таємниці марсіанських глибин. Грайте наодинці або з друзями у спільному режимі на 4 гравців, шукаючи зниклу команду. Виживайте в дивному інопланетному світі, створюючи інструменти й покращуючи базу.

games.title: Persona 4 Revival
games.description: Pre-order now and receive exclusive bonuses that will elevate your Persona 4 Revival experience! Early purchasers will unlock the P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set, featuring iconic music tracks from Persona 3 Reload and Persona 5 Royal that will be available for selection within the game. Persona 4 Revival: P3R & P5R Extra BGM Set Persona 3 Reload BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: Basement (P3R ver.) 2. Boss Battle BGM: Heartful Cry 3. Result BGM: After the Battle (P3R ver.) Persona 5 Royal BGMs include: 1. Dungeon BGM: The Whi

games.title: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
games.description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.description: Із полум’я війни постає фенікс. Рольова гра у жанрі темного фентезі Three Kingdoms від Team NINJA. Опануйте акробатичні прийоми китайських бойових мистецтві підкоріть безкраї поля битв у Three Kingdoms, де вам протистоятимуть могутні генерали й demons.

games.title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.description: Atelier Karia розповідає про шукачку пригод, яка втратила спогади й мусить зіткнутися з минулим. Нові функції урізноманітнюють битви й алхімію. Синтезовані згодяться в дослідженнях, а інгредієнти дають різні ефекти.

games.title: Fable
games.description: Станьте героєм власних мрій в цій атмосферній рольовій грі з відкритим світом, де кожне рішення впливає на ваш шлях, репутація важливіша за все інше, а щасливий кінець ніхто не гарантує.

games.title: METRO 2039
games.description: METRO 2039 — новий знаковий шутер від першої особи від 4A Games, визнаних майстрів оповіді. Вирушайте в саме серце темної постапокаліптичної Москви, де на вас чекає жорстоке протистояння, від якого залежить доля Метро.

games.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX
games.description: A new semester begins as fan-favorite RPG card game Yu-Gi-Oh! GX TAG FORCE 3 is reborn as Yu-Gi-Oh! TAG FORCE GX with modern visuals, enhanced Dueling, and nostalgic cards from the Yu-Gi-Oh! GX anime era.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
games.description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.title: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
games.description: У ліках, що дарують життя, прихована отрута. ПРО ГРУ Виготовляйте трав'яні ліки й покладайтеся на кмітливість і дедукцію, щоб розкрити правду про «П'ять таємниць» і «П'ять проклять» — дві низки дивних явищ і змов, що сіють хаос у задньому палаці, кварталі розваг і на вулицях столиці. Аптекарці Maomao доведеться застосувати всю свою кмітливість і знання, щоб розгадати таємниці й розкрити правду про фальшивого брата імператора. ЗБИРАЙТЕ ЗАЧІПКИ Й РОЗГАДУЙТЕ ТАЄМНИЦІ Опитуйте свідків, проводьте розслідування на місцях

games.title: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
games.description: Станьте пілотом, яким вам судилося бути. Змініть долю людства в GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, динамічному екшені, що по-новому розкриває Gundam через кінематографічну історію та нищівні бої.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.description: Отримайте задоволення від приголомшливого рімейку першої пригоди Лари Крофт і відкрийте загублені таємниці Атлантиди завдяки неймовірній графіці, сучасному ігровому процесу та сюрпризам, які зберігають дух оригіналу.

games.title: Tropico 7
games.description: Все або нічого! У Tropico 7 ви знову взуваєте блискучі черевики Ель-Президента, щоб розбудувати свою острівну державу і - в буквальному сенсі - звернути гори. Як славний лідер, ви ведете своїх вірних громадян (і свій рахунок у швейцарському банку) до невимовного процвітання.

games.title: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.description: Пробивайтеся крізь спотворені світи разом зі своїм супутником, драконом-богом, у насиченому адреналіном пригодницькому платформері, що поєднує вільний ближній бій, пливкий платформінг і науково-фантастичні дослідження. Станьте обранцем занепалого бога, Ельти.

games.title: Arizona Sunshine®
games.description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

games.title: Feudums
games.description: Feudums — це симулятор середньовічної стратегії з унікальною системою васалітету, повною підтримкою модифікації та розповіддями, які створюватиме игрова спільнота. Збалансуйте дипломатичні, економічні та військові аспекти, борючись за трон. Чи судилося вам правити?

games.title: Sheep Tag 2
games.description: Your friends are sheep. You are the wolf. Hunt them down as they build ridiculous farm fortresses to keep you out. Sheep Tag 2 is a Free-To-Play chaotic team-based RTS that's easy to learn and brutal to master. Play solo with bots or battle multiplayer with up to 32 players. Build. Hunt. Survive.

games.title: Altiros
games.description: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.title: Razgovor Online
games.description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

games.title: Drachenquell
games.description: Willkommen in der Welt von Drachenquell, einem epischen Abenteuer, das dich in eine Ära voller Mythen und Legenden entführt. Erkunde die weitläufigen Länder von Drachenquell, wo jede Ecke der Karte mit Leben gefüllt ist.

games.title: Crafted Legends
games.description: Build awesome racing tracks, challenge other players' ghosts, and discover what happens when realistic physics meets questionable driving skills. Create, race, crash, repeat. Roads are optional. Gravity isn't. Welcome to Crafted Legends, where even your worst ideas deserve a test drive.

games.title: Galaxy Gang
games.description: JUMP into the Ultimate Universe as Danny, a ten‑year‑old kid who suddenly finds himself wrapped up in a cosmic adventure way bigger than he ever expected. Galaxy Gang gives you a fast, colorful introduction to the worlds, characters, and movement that define the game.

games.title: Poker Warlords
games.description: Poker but your cards fight to win the pot. Turn cards into armies, complete combos for more power, and claim victory on the battlefield and at the betting table! From the creators of a top-10 StarCraft II custom game, this is poker like you've never played before.

games.title: 西部打打 Western Brawl
games.description: In a quiet western town, the righteous gunslinger Hannah finds herself surrounded by enemies from all directions inside a saloon. Draw your revolver, take down waves of ruthless outlaws, and fight your way through intense gunfights to carve out a path to survival!

games.title: Dstroy 2
games.description: Dstroy 2 is a solo or couch co-op 2d Pixelart puzzle-action adventure, and an orthogonal maze top-down Battle-royal competitive game inspired by the famous Bomberman game series. It's a sequel of Dstroy , our first game release in 1995 on Ms-dos. The final game will propose three Main modes: Adventure ( solo or co-op ). Adventure mode is actually not available in the demo. It will be possible to play it Solo or Coop with friends, like the first Dstroy. Tournaments ( Vs 2 to 4 players ). Local tournaments (player VS

games.title: Farwoods
games.description: A world of storybook roleplaying inspired by works like Redwall and Ironclaw. Join a player-driven living world of fantasy and adventure, contribute to the player-run economy, and help contribute to the organic narratives created by the community.

games.title: Witch Slide
games.description: Skate and explore a fantastical world of ice and snow on your own or team up with other witches. Carve spells into the snow, overcome challenges and race your friends! Singe-player and 2-4 player online co-op supported

games.title: Municipal Ghosts
games.description: Drift to charge your boost in Municipal Ghosts, an arcade racer built around Time Attack and a single-player Route Book. Race salvaged industrial machines through the city's forgotten infrastructure, take on crew challenges, and chase your next personal best.

games.title: Multi Idle
games.description: An idle RPG featuring a large focus on the customization of your play style to make every run unique. Create unbreakable skill combinations and advance your fighter to the point that even boss monsters will fear their strength!

games.title: MicroMayhem
games.description: The party game that doesn't give you time to think: 100+ five-second micro-games, faster and faster. 4 players on one screen, up to 8 online, or solo, with RICO and ZIP calling it live. Remote Play Together: only one copy needed!

games.title: Future Fall
games.description: A multiplayer post-apocalyptic survival action game with RPG elements set at the crossroads of two realities. Explore the Exclusion Zone, hunt artifacts in anomalies, manage your sanity, build your personal bunker, engage in free trade, and lead your clan to victory.

games.title: Fractured Mind
games.description: Hi, welcome to the Fractured Mind. This is a PT inspired psychological horror game, with a bodycam style (shocking, I know, there aren't a lot of those lately...). It's ~25-35 minutes of gameplay. The full game will be over 1 hour, I don't know for sure the full length yet. It's a fairly simple and straightforward game, with a heavy focus on atmosphere. There are also puzzles and shooting elements (which will be expanded upon in the full build). The HUD is almost entirely non existent, with the exception of the cro

games.title: SKYHELL
games.description: Travel through time in the elevator of an old murder house. To survive, avoid killers and place cameras in the right spots to track their movements.

games.title: 能動的ダンジョン
games.description: This game is a simple, high-difficulty RPG for people who are tired of the same old turn-based command-based RPGs. You can enjoy strategic battles where you respond to enemy attacks and manage a stamina-like energy called 'SP (Spirit),' as well as the freedom to create builds by configuring your equipment. ◎Primary target audience for this game People who play games regularly. People who want to enjoy the game more than the story. People who want to enjoy a high-difficulty command-based turn-based RPG. People who w

games.title: TritonXR: Reality Warfare
games.description: TritonXR turns ANY space into a dynamic combat arena with your friends - duck behind your living room couch to reload, throw a grenade down your hallway or jump over your bed to avoid an attack. This is the world's most advanced XR FPS.

games.title: Escape With Friends
games.description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

games.title: Addie Shen
games.description: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.title: Roleplay Passion
games.description: Step into a universe where every word matters and every choice opens unexpected paths. This is not your typical dating sim: here, the characters don’t follow fixed scripts they listen, react, and evolve with you.

games.title: A Developer Nightmare
games.description: You’re stuck in a dream and must run a special program on your computer to escape. Anomalies in the house disturb you, increasing your stress. Work with 2 or more Players to clear them before your stress consumes you.

games.title: Family Time
games.description: You're a Father Now All of a sudden you have to take care of dozens of wolf children! Every night their number grows! Fail to do so and your partner, the Wolf Mama, will kill you! How many can you sustain? Shelter Your Family! Build houses for them, or command them to build them for you! Feed your Family! Farm food for them or go out hunting with them! Pamper your Family! Keep them snug in their own beds to not anger the Wolf Mama! Can you support 10 children? 100? 1000? 10,000? Find out.

games.title: Spells and Sploobies
games.description: A tactical hex-grid card game for 2–4 players where wizards clash in strategic PvP duels. Build your deck, summon units, build structures, cast abilities, and issue commands to fight for control of the board.

games.title: TreeTale
games.description: TreeTale is a HACK&SLASH ARPG that combines limitless customization with strategic combat. Players can freely build their characters using an extensive Passive Tree, while the Skill Customization System allows them to refine their combat style to perfection.

games.title: Jump Frog
games.description: A determined frog leaps ever higher, risking its life in a perilous climb where every slip could send it tumbling back to the start. driven by the call to find the perfect mate. Will this frog have what it takes?

games.title: MoonLit Journey: The Age of Deth
games.description: Join us on an Epic Journey into the warped minds of life long gamers who are creating a nostalgic game, setting the player deep into a fantasy realm with a rich story line and many interactive features.

games.title: 岛岛岛
games.description: Island Island Island is a low-poly cartoon-style sandbox survival crafting game. Set in an infinitely dynamically generated world of floating islands, all terrain unfolds in real time as you move—the map has no boundaries.

games.title: Super Cucumber
games.description: Super Cucumber mixes Saturday morning cartoon charm with fast-paced action platforming. Play as Cucumber, an aardvark superhero, dashing, leaping, and comboing through 100+ handcrafted levels filled with new abilities, hidden secrets, and delightfully devious foes.

games.title: Crimson Crisis
games.description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

games.title: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
games.description: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

games.title: SCORCHED EARTH
games.description: SCORCHED EARTH is a chunky PS2 mecha-action game with massive amounts of customization, where you play as a mercenary taking on dirty jobs across a planetary war.

games.title: Sandtable Engine
games.description: Welcome to the sandbox world full of creativity! With a free and open gameplay mode and a creative platform, whether you are a player or a developer, you can find highly scalable gameplay and game modes, or DIY your own game ideas here!

games.title: Kids of Karendow
games.description: Kids of Karendow is a pixel-art fantasy sci-fi JRPG about a war built on lies. Play both sides: join Elmo, a resistance fighter who can't look away from injustice, and Kommander Krewl, the Daughter of Death, as the truth forces former enemies together against something far worse.

games.title: MusicLabeLManager 2K21
games.description: MusicLabelManager is a music industry simulator that allows players to create and run their own record label. Players take the role of CEO and try to make their mark on the music industry. The game has a database with more than 1000 real artists with stats for 2021. Music awards, singles, concert tours, streaming services and much more. The best music tycoon on the market! Six different music genres Everyone is a challenge! Hit the charts in any genre and claim a special award! Manage every aspect of your growing b

games.title: 轮回江湖
games.description: 沙盒武侠网游。 游戏形式为挂机攻击NPC。 攻击NPC可以获得武功熟练度，同时有概率掉落材料进背包。 除了挂机房，全地图可以pk。物品不掉落。 所有材料物品均可以交易。 玩家可以合成物品。 玩家可以自创武功。 游戏内NPC不产出铜币。 游戏内NPC不回收铜币。 铜币由官方免费派发或者玩家内购获得。 铜币的回收途径只有交易行和面对面交易，交易行和面对面交易税率初始为2% 玩家可以跨服邮寄铜币。 帮派系统。副职业系统

games.title: 祓ノ狐
games.description: Purifying Fox is a Japanese-style action adventure inspired by a book found in an old shrine storehouse. The story shifts between two phases: Escape, where you cannot fight and must survive, and Purification, where you seal the spirits and restore balance.

games.title: Constellations: Beyond the edges
games.description: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

games.title: Residuum
games.description: Defend your base on Mars from invaders in Residuum. A thrilling mix of tower defense and shooter gameplay, upgrade weapons and choose your crew for a unique experience each time. Play with a friend for even more excitement!

games.title: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
games.description: Use the rules of the famous Tower of Hanoi puzzle, where a larger piece cannot be on top of a smaller one. Each move the piece is flipped, changing its pole, * Equal poles repel and opposites poles attract stack negative and positive pole towers Complete the level by stacking positive and negative towers in their respective places to energize and enlighten the board. Resources: More than 30 carefully designed levels; Atmospheric soundtrack and SFX to help you immerse yourself; Fast paced gameplay, perfect for those

games.title: Ink Shapes: Book One
games.description: Organize by rotating ink-filled stamps to form beautiful shapes, When completing the puzzle the stamp is pressed on the paper, printing your watercolor painting! Features: 30 carefully designed levels; Original soundtrack composed especially to help you relax; Relaxing gameplay, perfect for those looking for casual puzzle; Beautiful hand-drawn watercolor art.

games.title: Far Dawn
games.description: A classic dark fantasy real-time strategy game, set in a state engulfed in an internal ethnic conflict. Witness centuries-old hatreds and newly reignited distrust fuel the flames of war, and be forced to pick your side: will you fight for the integrity of the realm, or the freedom of your nation?

games.title: 无生之荣
games.description: Murder in a back room? Headless corpses? Disappearing murder weapon? Deadly messages?Murder? Suicide? You want it, it's all here. Let's start from the bloodshed in the Imperial City that shook the nation, pull them out of their cocoons, and get a glimpse of the truth behind them.

games.title: Miuma
games.description: Miuma is a cozy game about a little, modest bakery with unexpected twists. The game features the significant feat of Kevin, the bakery’s new owner, and his venture within the middle of nowhere of which he calls his home.

games.title: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy!
games.description: Let's bounce! Popsicle boy! is a casual rogue-like game with mechanics inspired by Breakout. As you venture through different game chapters, fight against unique brick mechanics and powerful enemies while upgrading different skills to change the pace of the game!

games.title: God Of This World
games.description: What if classic RPGs were modern day 3D top-down shooters? You'll collect health, jewels, keys, bullets, shield bombs, unlock doors, destroy enemy portals, all while shooting down non-stop seeker robot enemies with regular and tactical guns, enemies who are all set to fire back.

games.title: BabushCats
games.description: BabushCats is a game where you play as a grandma managing a shelter for stray cats. Build trust and care for your kittens by day, and fight their nightmares by night. Face off hordes of enemies and defeat cats' biggest fear, BUZZ.

games.title: Clock Overwhelmed
games.description: Clock Overwhelmed is a game that brings criticism to modern times, in which you have more and more tasks to do and you have to solve a real puzzle to try to fit all your activities. Shoot all tasks in the blank spaces of your watch, without overlapping any activity! Features: 30 carefully designed levels; Original soundtrack composed especially to help you stay immersed in the game; Addictive gameplay, perfect for those looking for casual action games; Beautiful Lowpoly art style.

games.title: All the King's Men
games.description: Join Topher in this classic-styled JRPG as he traverses the country to figure out how his family is linked to the disappearance of the King. Fight & explore this open-world adventure, as you team up with others along this path of self-discovery and defining what an individual's life is truly worth.

games.title: They Fear The Mist
games.description: They Fear The Mist is a real-time strategy game, where you command your Troops, build your Settlement, fight off thousands of Enemies and explore the Unknowns of the Mist. Take command of your people and defend them from the incoming hordes… Can you survive?

games.title: World Turned Stone
games.description: Civilization has turned STONE. Revive the people, terraform the world, defend against the apocalypse, and rebuild civilization from the stone age to advanced technology! Prologue link below.

games.title: LastDitch
games.description: 'LastDitch' combines 2D tower defense and auto-chess, immersing players in a futuristic clash against void creatures. Strategically choose pieces barricades for defense, barracks for minions, fortresses for high damage. Experience intense battles, unique pixel art style, profound strategic depth.

games.title: HYPERFATAL
games.description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

games.title: ASMR Food Experience: Prologue
games.description: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full game. If you are looking for tones that will put you in an amazing mood, you've come to the right place! In the game, we have connected the game with the tones of the world around us. Open, manage, and listen to your own restaurant!

games.title: Forum Mortuorum
games.description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

games.title: Deathly Reprieve
games.description: Strategize, adapt, and shoot your way through enemy lines. In this ruthless, story-driven tactical shooter, precision is the difference between life and death. Lead a mercenary organization through a blood-soaked, near-futuristic world, as you uncover a global conspiracy. Do you have what it takes?

games.title: RATKING
games.description: Become The Salary Man. Unleash ZA BLADE. Save Your Boss. Experience a life OFF ZA CLOCK. a Uniquely Surreal Action Combat, Player Choice Fueled, Point & Click Adventure.

games.title: PRECOGNITION
games.description: After receiving an experimental implant, Diana gains the ability to see her own future. Use her ability to navigate kaleidoscopic possibilities and change the world for the better… or for the worse. PRECOGNITION is the new sci-fi horror game from Sam Barlow and Brandon Cronenberg.

games.title: Greatest Dungeon
games.description: Soulslike PvPvE medieval Dungeon-crawler, with extraction possibility and incoming zone. The Combat is Physicbased and has dismemberment, higher speed-stats of yours slowdown enemy's, and projectiles, you can find rare Items or NPCs in the Dungeon that give you Quests or fight Bosses.

games.title: Shellbound
games.description: Shellbound is a 2D metroidvania set on a gigantic snail. You’re a parasite exploring a living world, battling and controlling enemies that will cause the ecosystem to evolve around you. Platform through diverse biomes, solve puzzles, and unravel your role in the giant creature’s life cycle.

games.title: Financial Freedom
games.description: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑🏻‍🏭🏭 to a millionaire! 💸💸

games.title: SeverLink
games.description: SeverLink — це ретро-гра в жанрі стелс-екшен, натхненна консолями початку 2000-х років, такими як Splinter Cell, MGS2-3 та Hitman Contracts. Художній стиль відтворює унікальну естетику ігор для PlayStation 2.

games.title: Wolfstar Adventures in the Inu System
games.description: A sci-fi action-adventure platformer. Travel the Inu System and talk to a colorful cast of NPCs across various worlds. Explore maze-like levels by running, double jumping, and dashing. Fight off various robotic enemies using special melee attacks, and eventually take down the boss of each dungeon.

games.title: Space gold rush TD
games.description: Join in on the next gold rush and become a prospector in space. In this unique tower defense you can set up and reposition towers for maximum efficiency and adapt to the environment.

games.title: Zoe's Game
games.description: Escape from a mansion full of puzzles, traps and characters who may not be what they seem! Can you survive to this deadly birthday party?

games.title: Villainville
games.description: Join the outcasts of Villainville in this cozy farming sim adventure where Stardew Valley meets Shrek. Grow magic crops, tame the tiny unicorns, sneak into the night market, and befriend misfit fairy tale characters. Bonus? Find the misery mushroom plague saboteur and redeem the irredeemable.

games.title: Non-Euclidean Design
games.description: Have you ever played a non-Euclidean game and wondered if it would be nice to design with it? Have you ever played a house designing game and not have enough space in your room or house? Non-Euclidean Design is the answer. This game lets you fix up your non-Euclidean house without restraints of Euclidean space. Your house can be bigger on the inside, rooms can take up the same space, and doors can serve as portals to other rooms in the house. Currently, the game will be played in Sandbox, but eventually with the ad

games.description: Explore a quirky top-down RPG/platformer as Jeff and Crackhead! Solve puzzles, dodge traps, and uncover secrets in the overworld. Battles mix turn-based strategy with real-time action—dodge, parry, and unleash powerful combos. Fast-paced, simple, and packed with nonsensical fun!

games.title: StellarFighter: Galactica
games.description: Lead your starfighter as a bounty hunter, complete contracts and fight your way to free your home system from a criminal empire full of conspiracies and underworld secrets, in this hard boiled action old school arcade shooter.

games.title: SUPER DEBT
games.description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

games.title: Digital Artmaster: Volume 8
games.description: Explore the artistry behind stunning digital worlds with this exclusive visual artbook. Featuring high-resolution artwork, intricate designs, and breathtaking environments, it offers a glimpse into the creative process, perfect for fans of imaginative storytelling and digital art.

games.title: Dining Deck
games.description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!

games.title: I'm a Human
games.description: Забудьте про захист. Це зворотна оборона вежі, де ви — загроза. Керуйте штучним інтелектом, будуйте роботів та знищуйте людські бази. Ваша мета — вторгнення. Ваша зброя — рій.

games.title: Full Duplex
games.description: Two eyes. Two hands. One brain. Pilot two independent vehicles at once in this single-player co-op, coordinating flanks, feints, and split objectives entirely solo. Full Duplex is a true test of focus: can your mind run two fronts at once?

games.title: Chaoslands
games.description: This game is a pixel-styled, turn-based sandbox game. Collect around 50 items and build or find 100 obstacles accross the world. Build ships to cross water and enter the caves to collect advanced resources. Fight 2 bosses and level up.

games.title: Guild of Slayers
games.description: Survivors-like in full 3D with ragdoll physics. Enemies throw themselves at you as projectiles, crash into allies, and damage each other. Bodies fly. Chaos reigns. Survive waves of undead in the most satisfying horde-slaughter you've ever seen. 🔥💀

games.title: Guardian Order
games.description: 1-4 co-op action roguelite where you explore ever-changing dungeons with your allies. games.title: Snowbound: Steam Voyage
games.description: You drive your steam-powered truck across the snowbound wastelands left by the Great Frostfall. Ice has claimed the world, but not your resolve. Scavenge, rebuild, and cultivate what life remains. Somewhere in the endless white, the past still breathes

games.title: Celestial Conquest
games.description: Blast off in this retro-style space shooter! Conquer planets, outwit AI enemies, and survive the dangers of deep space in fast-paced, nostalgic pixel action.

games.title: Chess Peace
games.description: Find your way back to the surface by learning new movement patterns, out-maneuvring enemies, and helping stray figures in a surreal chess-inspired metroidbrainia.

games.title: Solis
games.description: Join Nina and RAM with a friend to explore the puzzles and challenges of Solis. Discover the mysteries and the natural and technological wonders of Tortuga Island as you embark on a journey toward the abandoned factory. Play in local split-screen co-op or online using the Friend Pass.

games.title: Untitled Project
games.description: Unravel the secrets of a sprawling metropolis in this gripping third-person adventure. Explore a vast cityscape, engage with intriguing characters, and unravel mysteries and crimes. But beware—the shadows hold danger, and thugs lurk around every corner.

games.title: Raven Gold
games.description: Raven Gold is a classic-style RPG featuring a handcrafted world. Explore unique dungeons, defeat powerful enemies, and conquer challenging puzzles to find rewarding treasure! Manage your resources carefully, especially your money, to achieve long term success as a fledgling adventurers guild.

games.title: Прекрасний у смерті
games.description: Гра, представлена від першої особи, з особливимъ наголосомъ на діалоги та історичну достовірність, дія котрої розгортається у літа з 1848-хъ по 1901-і роки. Вамъ належить увійти у роль фотографа з суворими вусами, що присвятивъ себе ремеслу посмертної фотографії.

games.title: 哈基米的海上漂流
games.description: A survival shooter game set at sea, where players must gather supplies, locate hidden shelters, and build rafts to survive. On the ocean surface, you'll need to fish with a rod, diligently collect drifting supplies with hooks, construct rafts, and grow food to stay alive.

games.description: From the creators of Firewatch, In the Valley of Gods is a single-player first-person adventure. games.title: Timberquest
games.description: Embark on an adventure in our RPG game! Explore a new, wild continent and fight to survive against environmental factors and monsters. With a heavy focus on cooperative play. Customize your character's stat-driven abilities to suit your preferred playstyle.

Handcra

games.description: Umbra's Cauldron is a 2D card-stacking game in which every element of the game is a card. You have turned into a book and are now looking for a way to get back to your original form. Combine cards, discover recipes and fill your blank pages with knowledge.

games.title: GrimmVale
games.description: GrimmVale is a story-rich RPG set in a dark world of twisted fairy tales. Chased from her home, separated from her parents, and pursued by Wolves and Witches, Jill must gather allies and seek out the sources of magic to bring down the dreaded Wolf King, and regain the peace and family she has lost.

games.description: Очольте «Світанок» в Ефесі доби Нерона. Готуйте склади й тактики для 5 на 5 → 3 на 3 → 2 на 2 та втручайтеся в бій. Витрачайте призові на викуп, погоджуйте контракти з вільними бійцями, тренуйте й споряджайте загін, ходіть у рейди, повертайтеся сильнішими на арену й піднімайтеся з 5-го дивізіону.

games.title: Same End
games.description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of having to deal with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

games.title: 奇路迷踪 The Road 66
games.description: The Road 66 is a 2D pixel art adventure where Kai and childhood friends Sue and Nile hit the road to find the brothers' missing mother. Along Route 66, they’ll encounter talking cats, dancing fire gods, and eerie folklore. Start the engine—adventure awaits!

games.title: ZEROSEGI
games.description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

games.title: 喵雪小萌萌
games.description: Nyaukimoe is an anime and pixel art style catgirl Metroidvania platformer. Play as Nyaukimoe, fighting and exploring dark areas with a Cat Scratcher and glowsticks, searching for her lost sister.

games.title: Fish Market
games.description: A cosy fish market simulator where you cut fresh fish, turn them into products like sushi, and collect rare species. Build a peaceful market, master satisfying preparation mechanics, and grow your seafood business at your own pace.

games.title: MOKI - The Escape
games.description: Awaken without memory in a seemingly peaceful world. In this 2.5D puzzle-platformer, use the gift of the Streak (short-range teleportation), whose potential unfolds over time. Encounter fascinating creatures and uncover the truth that waits in hiding.

games.title: Formula Team
games.description: Formula team management. The Formula Team will allow you to play the role of a team director, the success of the entire team will depend on you. If you are a huge Formula fan and have always been excited about the racing atmosphere? This game is made just for you.

games.title: Onlympic Up!
games.description: A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes: “Your fates are now bound.” Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable. Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm. Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

games.title: Villages™
games.description: Villages™ is a game that combines interesting mechanics from many other sandbox games. It aims to let People face a variety of gameplay and scenario by conducting a few basic rules. KEY FEATURES Economy, the game's world will have limited resources, so ones will not get the same resources and amount. People will then form an economy by using the trading system in the game. games.title: Mister Gato Idle - The Meowsiah
games.description: Mister Gato Idle: це гра idle/incremental для '2nd Monitor'. Грайте за кота в смокінгу з banjo, удосконалюйте The Mew Sound і ставайте Meowsiah. Перемагайте ворогів, збирайте валюту і лут, створюйте остаточну зброю.

games.title: Vampire vs Devil
games.description: Використовуй тіла своїх ворогів як зброю. Шукай ключі, щоб відчиняти двері. Використовуй хитрощі, щоб бути швидшим. Один неправильний рух — і ти мертвий, але у тебе стільки життів, скільки потрібно, щоб пройти 666 рівнів до пекла. Останній бос, сам Диявол, чекає на тебе. Спробуй битися з ним, якщо наважишся... Vampire vs Devil — це моторошний 2D платформер з ретро-графікою в стилі піксель-арт, подібний до старих ігрових консолей. Твоя мета — перемогти ворогів і завершити кожен із 666 рівнів. games.title: ANAMNESIS: memoria war
games.description: Will you die and be free of pain? Or live and break the shackles of fate? Can two souls, bound by fate itself, sever the never-ending cycle of death? 'ANAMESIS: memoria war' is a gorgeous 2D jRPG rich in story, heavy on action and steeped in deep characterization.

games.title: Bring Me Hope
games.description: Bring Me Hope - це гірко-солодка пригодницька RPG про кохання, втрату та сім’ю. Досліджуйте світ відлунь і спогадів, де кожен бій випробовує вашу рішучість, а кожна таємниця шепоче про щось більше.

games.title: Jasper's Dream
games.description: Jasper's Dream is a first person puzzle game set in a techno mystic Egyptian world. Help Jasper, a robot programmed to create games, by solving his mind-bending puzzles. You will also explore an abandonned futuristic pyramid and unravel its many mysteries.

games.title: Goojeegoop
games.description: Клікай-клікай-КЛІКАЙ і проривайся крізь нескінченні хвилі ворогів у захопливому новому point-and-click roguelike — і ставай неймовірно сильним! Клікай по ворогах, щоб відкривати нові слоти, підвищувати рівень і створювати божевільні та видовищні білди!

games.title: LoopCraft
games.description: Loop Craft is a game about economics. There is an item trading system within the game. This game has a variety of item mix systems. And have a reservation system to set up a factory to produce products for sale in the game.

games.title: 封禅记(The Legend of Zen Town)
games.description: The Legend of Zen Town is a classic turn-based RPG driven by a rich narrative. Explore a world where Chinese folklore blends with vibrant street culture, hidden beneath a modern city. Uncover supernatural mysteries and ancient secrets through striking art and storytelling.

games.title: Tidespawn
games.description: Занурся у магічний світ цієї піксельної пригодницької RPG. Досліджуй затоплені руїни, бийся з морськими чудовиськами, віднови забуті спогади та стань господарем своєї долі у небезпечних глибинах.

games.title: Waste Of Life
games.description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

games.title: PlayLife: Life Deck Simulator
games.description: A card-based life simulation where every choice is a card. Build your deck, shape your destiny, and explore multiple paths with 21 skills and 22 careers. Marry, stay single, get rich, or start over—every run tells a new life story.

games.title: Plague hunter
games.description: Plague hunter is an indie platformer game in the dark fantasy vein. In the game you’ll be using sword and gun to cut your way through hordes of zombies and other terrible monsters, avoiding deadly traps.

games.title: Sneak Pit
games.description: Sneak Pit is the working title for an EXTREMELY alpha stealth / immersive sim experience. Use a variety of weapons and items to outsmart the enemy and access restricted areas crucial to your mission. More details and features to come.

games.title: The Guardians Realm
games.description: The Guardians Realm is an open-world Fantasy RPG in a medieval setting. games.title: Keystone Titans VR
games.description: Keystone Titans VR is a VR Autobattler where units will need to be strategically selected and arranged to dominate your opponents. Outsmart the enemy with clever drafting, positioning, and economy management to form the strongest team.

games.title: 天朝远征军
games.description: 'Dynasty Rush' is an official Chinese-themed TD game. Command legendary heroes and unique towers across iconic Chinese landscapes. Experience deep strategy infused with rich culture as you defend the realm. The vast empire awaits your command!

games.title: Destination Empire
games.description: Destination Empire is a 3D platformer hack-and-slash with fast tactical RPG elements. Fight large enemy groups, stop time with Kairos, quickly reskill to adapt your tactics, and switch to first person to uncover alternative solutions.

games.title: Ever Fallen Empire
games.description: A Strategic Empire Collapser. As The Authority. Manage a living galaxy, and plan large-scale actions according to your needs. Collapse governments, inflame rebellions, seed new factions, and sacrifice your own. All for purposes grander than any Empire could hold.

games.title: Wagrrr
games.description: Give your viewers more FUN and INTERACTIVITY with your broadcasts! Let your viewers respond live on-screen to your gameplay, send text and questions, and make FUN wagers on your Battle Royale Games! ADD AN EXTRA LAYER OF FUN TO YOUR BROADCASTS!

games.title: The Electric Odyssey
games.description: We are all familiar with the apocalypse. The end of the world, beginning of a new age. It isn't over for everyone though, some resist. There is a way out, but it won't be easy. Androids were predictable, but it still seemed too sudden. Could someone else be pulling the strings?

games.title: Samuda Interval
games.description: Samuda Interval is a visual novel, slice-of-life, murder mystery & supernatural game. You play the daily life of Park Haewon or Park Sae-il, a college freshman attending classes, working part-time jobs, and meeting new people. Solving the serial kidnapping & murder case is your highest priority.

games.title: Claria's Great Maze
games.description: Behind the Claria's Great Maze is the last village of humanity, and the maze is also the last barrier for humans to block enemies. And you are the last guardian of magic, the last hope of humanity.

games.title: BoxSim
games.description: In BoxSim, think outside the box while inside of a box that's inside of a box. Find creative solutions to puzzles. Navigate platforming challenges. Pick up and put down boxes. Will you escape, or will you spend the rest of your life inside the box?

games.title: OMAPELI
games.description: OMAPELI is an action RPG setting in a medieval fantasy world. Explore different biomes and enter underworld dungeons. Meet friendly NPCs, hear their quests and trade. Fully customize your character. Craft your weapons - swords, bows and magic.
